title: U.S.-India Insight: India’s Trade Deals: Only a Starting Point to Progress
summary_en: India's trade deals with Australia and the UAE have boosted bilateral trade significantly, but neither partner has meaningfully shifted in India's overall trade mix. The real work lies in domestic reform, not deal-making.

title: Fueling Discontent
